Chats show their recent history immediately and load earlier messages as you scroll. Streaming Markdown and transcript projections reuse finished work, while native events wake the interface without a constant gateway poll.

Hidden computer and agent-browser viewers pause their streams and resume with a fresh observation. Failed thumbnails stop animating, and workspace file listings load when needed.

Media-only provider configurations keep text catalogs empty. Codex and OpenAI WebSocket text catalogs remain locked; image and live catalogs are configured independently in the gateway.

Bundles gateway 0.16.30 with batched streaming records, fewer transport writes and usage updates that avoid copying the full usage history. Protocol 92 and gateway config version 28 are unchanged. Build 13.
